parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of gender identity and no universal birth-sex facility rule documented; instead a functioning equality court, an equality statute reaching gender identity, and a 2024 hate-crime/hate-speech statute covering gender identity, plus a binding Nov 2025 precedent ordering gender-affirming care, clothing and SOP implementation for a trans inmate. Courts demonstrably work FOR trans people, so rule of law mitigates. Negatives: medical-model LGR and binary-only markers (mostly resident-facing/climate), a documented 2024 police mockery and refusal to take a trans woman's complaint, contested bathroom access with no ruling, and township violence against visibly trans women. The only violence figures are undated raw counts without denominators, so no trans-specific rate can be derived; the tavern assault saw an arrest. Social attitudes broadly favourable but dated and uneven. Strong legal framework plus operating remedies, tempered by unresolved facility access and official friction, places this in the reduced-risk band.
